text: Fortune being changeful and mankind steadfast in their ways, so long as the two are in agreement men are successful, but unsuccessful when they fall out. For my part I consider that it is better to be adventurous than cautious.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
locator: Chapter XXV, What fortune can effect in human affairs and how to withstand her
location: Sant'Andrea in Percussina, near Florence, Italy
